scope: Postprocess all 490 existing points; no new FEM solve. Separate mesh-pair change from one-sided stress spread. Classify M1 side pairs by logical element indices i/profile, j/Y, k/thickness; retain multi-direction pairs separately. Adjacent single-axis pairs must share opposite natural-coordinate faces.
limits: Direction of a stress jump is not proof of its cause
No extrapolation to faces, support singularities or unmeasured peaks
No replacement of prior acceptance by directional maxima
No actual support/joint selection, design or manufacturing approval
